'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 WIRFS DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
